prose.intro: Choose a weather scenario, a cooling level and a controller. The annual energy stack is available for the thermostat and the exact optimum (a full-year simulation); the planner and the rule were simulated for the eight test weeks, so they appear in the heat-wave-week view and in the numbers of the test weeks.
prose.week_note: The heat-wave week is the July test week. The thermostat and optimum curves continue a year-long simulation; the rule and the planner start the week from empty tanks after a warm-up, so the first hours can differ a little between the two groups. Values are district sums of the six buildings.
prose.missing_note: This controller was not simulated for this cell. The hourly week was simulated for the heat-wave scenarios with no cooling and with high cooling.
